You should not be moved by another person's success. Their time isn't your time.

July 31 2 min read Latunde Akin

You should not be moved by another person's success. Their time isn't your time.
Yes,rejoice very well with them but don't feel any less of yourself.
One thing that makes you to be successful too is when you are genuinely happy about another person's success.
If you're always feeling sad that you have not achieved what others achieved, it simply means you have been already wired for failure.
If you like,have all the money or successes, it can't intimidate genuine men who understand timing and knows how to restore wasted opportunities.
Those who know their God shall be strong and do exploits.
You should simply rather understand how to relate well with successful people in your area of target.
You should understand how not to become a parasite. You must give value ,show value,and have something to solve around people.
You should not create any atmosphere that places burden on others but lifts burden from others.
The best way is to understand your place in destiny and stay there to DEVELOP yourself.
Your time too will come. Unless you have derailed from God's plan.
And anyone who derailed from God's plan for his/her life is already lost in destiny. Such are the kind of people who gets angry unnecessarily when they see others who are walking in their right path.
May we not be lost in life.
May we have the strength to begin afresh and succeed.
May our self confidence becomes restored to rise and rise again.
May our wasted years become restored.
May every dry bones rise again.
In Jesus name. Amen
Your brother
Latunde Akin
